title: Term Premium Proration Schedule — Builder Extended Rate Lock
content:
The rate premium of a Builder Extended Rate Lock term is prorated when the home's estimated completion falls well inside the lock term.

**Schedule.** The days needed are the calendar days from the lock request date to the Home Purchase Agreement's estimated completion date. Where the days needed fall short of the term's lock term days by more than 60 days, the term premium is the term's rate premium times the days needed divided by the lock term days; where they fall short by one day up to 60 days, the term premium is the term's rate premium times the sum of the days needed and 30, divided by the lock term days, never more than the term's rate premium; otherwise the term premium is the term's rate premium. The term premium enters the locked rate unrounded; the locked rate is rounded.

## Figures by term

| Lock term | Lock term days | Rate premium | Short by more than 60 days when days needed are | Short by 1 to 60 days when days needed are |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 60-Day Standard Lock | 60 | 0.000 | fewer than 0 | 0 to 59 |
| 90-Day Lock | 90 | 0.125 | 29 or fewer | 30 to 89 |
| 120-Day Extended Lock | 120 | 0.250 | 59 or fewer | 60 to 119 |
| 180-Day Extended Lock | 180 | 0.375 | 119 or fewer | 120 to 179 |
| 270-Day Build Lock | 270 | 0.500 | 209 or fewer | 210 to 269 |
| 360-Day Build Lock | 360 | 0.625 | 299 or fewer | 300 to 359 |

## Method by days needed

| Days needed | Term premium |
|---|---|
| short of the lock term days by more than 60 | rate premium times days needed divided by lock term days |
| short by 1 to 60 days | rate premium times (days needed plus 30) divided by lock term days, at most the rate premium |
| equal to or more than the lock term days | the rate premium |

## Worked cases (hypothetical, 180-Day Extended Lock)

- Days needed 100, short by 80: 0.375 times 100 divided by 180 is 0.208333...
- Days needed 130, short by 50: 0.375 times 160 divided by 180 is 0.333333...
- Days needed 150, short by 30: 0.375 times 180 divided by 180 is 0.375, the full premium.
- Days needed 165, short by 15: 0.375 times 195 divided by 180 exceeds the premium, so it is held at 0.375.
- Days needed 200: the full 0.375.
